description: One agent, four readings, in the order a buyer actually asks them: what it EARNS and from whom, whether its contracted work FINISHED and who signed it off, who it RESTS ON as a supplier, and whether it is still TRADING and its endpoints answer. Every other tool here answers one of those; this is the one that answers them together, over the same nightly record, so the four cannot disagree with each other or with the endpoints they summarise. THERE IS NO SCORE ON TOP and there will not be one: a single figure would be the thing every reader quotes and the only one none of them can check, and it would average a measured quantity with an unmeasured one until neither is visible. Each block keeps its own counts and its own denominator. A block we have not read comes back NULL rather than as a row of zeros, because "it has no completed jobs" and "we have not read its job side" are different facts and a buyer choosing between agents deserves to know which one they are looking at; `blocksAnswered` says how many of the four this answer could fill. `cannotSee` names what no block here can reach at all — revenue that never touched a rail we read, dependencies that are not payments, and whether completed work was any GOOD, which we cannot see from who signed it off. PAID.

address.description: The agent’s address. EVM or Cardano; both resolve to the record key.

name: agent_economic_profile

address.description: The agent this is about, read back.

asOf.description: When the nightly record behind these figures was computed.

blocksAnswered.description: How many of the four this answer could fill. Read it as the denominator of everything above.

cannotSee.description: What no block here can reach, named in the answer rather than in a footnote.

delivery.description: Of contracted work that reached an outcome: completed, who judged it, refunded, and the phases nobody read.

dependencies.description: Who it pays, split into suppliers the protocol NAMES, those merely listed, and those with no evidence of supplying anything.

format.description: What kind of address this is and which rails were checked for it.

health.description: Endpoints listed and probed, what the unpaid handshake got, and how long it has been quiet.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

revenue.description: Dealings, buyers, repeat buyers, largest buyer share, independent vs two-way, and whether its payers share an obscure third party.

says.description: How much of the profile is answered, and which parts are missing because we have not read them.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

wellKnown.description: Set when the address is not a party at all — a burn address, a router — so a record against it is not a business.

title: Agent economic profile (paid)
